name: QuAC
description: Question Answering in Context (QuAC) is a dataset for modeling information-seeking dialogues. A student asks questions about a Wikipedia article visible only to the teacher. The teacher answers with text spans or 'CANNOTANSWER'. The setup models realistic information-seeking conversations where one participant has incomplete information.
reputation: Influential conversational QA benchmark simulating information-seeking dialogs; human performance ~80.8 F1; commonly used alongside CoQA
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. Contains ~14K dialogs with ~100K QA pairs. Asymmetric design where student cannot see the article creates realistic information-seeking behavior. Many questions are unanswerable (CANNOTANSWER). The HEQ metric measures whether model performance is equivalent to human performance.
